paragraphs: Rav Chinena, son of Rava—Pesachim 76a has Rabbah. Chullin 112a: Rava said, “Who is as wise as R. Chinena son of Rava, for he is a great man?” Rava likewise said of Rav Chanin bar Yeiva, “Who is as wise?” Of Pashrunya: Rashi, Pesachim there, and Menachot 42b, beginning, explains Pashrunya as a place-name. Rav Ika bar Chanina of Pashrunya; see there.
